    Hubverse Developer CodeQL setup

    Source: R/use_hubdev_codeql.R
    use_hubdev_codeql.Rd

    Configures CodeQL code scanning on the package's GitHub repository to use the "extended" query suite, as the hubverse security policy requires.

    Usage

    use_hubdev_codeql(repo_spec = NULL)

    Arguments

    repo_spec

    Character string. The repository as "owner/repo". Defaults to the repository of the active project's upstream remote, or its origin remote when there is no upstream. In a fork checkout, upstream is the hubverse-org repository.

    Value

    The GitHub API response, invisibly. Called for its side effect.

    Details

    CodeQL default setup is enabled by default for public repositories in the hubverse GitHub organisation. Its "default" query suite does not detect third-party actions that are not pinned to a commit SHA. The "extended" suite does.

    CodeQL does not analyse R, so in a package it scans only the GitHub Actions workflows. Run this function once the workflows are on the default branch. Changing the code scanning configuration requires admin access to the repository.
